history.summary: THIS IS A CHRISTIAN CHURCH, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE. The Bawngkawn Presbyterian Church serves the Bawngkawn locality in northern Aizawl as a local congregation of the Mizoram Presbyterian Church Synod, Mizoram's largest Christian denomination (about 6,28,719 members in 2023), a constituent body of the Presbyterian Church of India with its headquarters at Mission Veng, Aizawl. The Synod traces its origin to 11 January 1894, when the Rev. J.H. Lorrain and Rev. F.W. Savidge arrived in the Lushai Hills (sent by the Arthington Aborigines Mission); the Welsh Calvinistic Methodist (later Presbyterian Church of Wales) mission, under Rev. D.E. Jones from 1897, took over the Aizawl field. The Synod as an organized administrative body dates to the early 20th century (1924 per the dataset brief - verify). Bawngkawn Presbyterian Church has hosted notable denominational events, including the commissioning of 104 new Synod Mission Board missionaries on 7 February 2016 and the 7th Kristian Thalai Pawl Biennial Business Meeting in March 2017. Bawngkawn also has sister Presbyterian churches such as Bawngkawn Chhimveng and Bawngkawn Hmarveng (verify which congregation the CSV row intends, or whether it refers to the Bawngkawn pastorate generally). Exact founding year and building history were not found in published sources (verify).

name: Bawngkawn Presbyterian Church
town_description: Aizawl is the capital and largest city of Mizoram, set on a ridge at about 1,132 m with the Tlawng river valley to its west and the Tuirial valley to its east. It is a predominantly Christian city where Christmas (Krismas) is the biggest festival, and churches are the centres of community life. Bawngkawn is a northern locality of Aizawl (PIN 796014), home to several Presbyterian churches including the Bawngkawn, Bawngkawn Chhimveng and Bawngkawn Hmarveng congregations. Visitors to Mizoram need an Inner Line Permit (ILP).

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (AJL), about 22 km from Aizawl; taxis and app cabs to Bawngkawn.
travel.railway: Sairang Railway Station, about 17 km from Aizawl, on the new Bairabi-Sairang line (inaugurated September 2025); Bairabi station about 100 km (verify).
travel.road: Bawngkawn is in north Aizawl, well connected by city buses and shared taxis from the city centre (Dawrpui/Zarkawt area).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, clear weather. Christmas and New Year are the most festive but crowded; Mizoram requires an Inner Line Permit for visitors from other Indian states.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services (typically Sunday morning worship and Sunday school, with evening services; typical Aizawl Presbyterian pattern - verify, not published). One listing gives daily 6:00 AM-8:00 PM building hours (verify). Visitors are welcome at services but should dress modestly.
